request: Owner 2026-11-09: run danMCai-reason (inference bot) vs the latest Clint bot, 500 matches.
focal: danMCai-reason-v000855042 (web id 9001) as deployed in 1.18.1: champion 017 (462afc99...) + hand-inference v1 (16d76783...), belief-world midgame search 21-40, belief-world 8-world exact PIMC <=20, champion elsewhere; tribute/return as the web computer seat; desktop budgets of the 60/50/10 rule (reasoning <= 50 s per move, solver min(3 s, time left), fallback 017).
opponent: Clint rules-v2 as synced from upstream clintsun1977/guandan through 30a8067 (rules + endgame brain, web path decideClintRule with the 30 s brain cap within 50 s), --clint=web.
design: 250 audited seeds (seeds.json, from seed-audit.json), each played twice with the reason team on seats 0/2 and then 1/3: 500 complete matches (levels, tribute/return, A levels, aFail=draw, 200-round cap) with the GuanZero development-suite per-round seeds.
primary: Focal match score per match (win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0) averaged over matches, 95% seed-pair cluster percentile bootstrap (2,000 draws). Evidence that danMCai-reason beats this Clint iff the lower bound > 0.5; evidence that it is worse iff the upper bound < 0.5.
secondary: Wins/losses/draws, net match score, mean final level difference, per-side results, A-failures, reason search fallbacks by band and reason, Clint brain calls/fallbacks/changes, timing. Both sides are time-budgeted, so results depend on machine load (other research jobs run concurrently on this Mac); fallback rates are reported with the result.
notCovered: Human players or partners, other opponents, mobile devices; this is a whole-match evaluation of the deployed Node-equivalent bot, not a web latency test.

run.note: launchd job; resumable by completed pairs; STOP file in the output directory stops it.
